# HBDM
```{r}
sub_name = c("sub-104", "sub-106", "sub-109")
human_type = 0
test_df = all_df[all_df$human == 0 & all_df$subjID %in% sub_name, ]

start.time = Sys.time()

test_fit = ug_delta(data = test_df,
  niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 4, nthin = 1,
  inits = "random",
  indPars = "mean",
  vb = FALSE,
  inc_postpred = FALSE,
  adapt_delta = 0.95,
  stepsize = 1,
  max_treedepth = 15,
)

end.time <- Sys.time()
time.taken_pp_check <- round(end.time - start.time,2)
print(time.taken_pp_check)
```
